Stack "card" hugs its children on this axis, so it grows to hold them: a negative offset is clamped to 0. Give the stack a fixed or fill size to let this child overhang its edge (as Flutter's Positioned with a negative offset), and clip with "decoration": {"clip": "hardEdge"}.
fixed is not honored here: Items in a list always fill across it.

A negative margin does not overlap neighbors (Flutter has no negative margins): it takes room from the node's own box. To overlap a neighbor, move what it paints: "motion": {"translateY": -36} (Flutter's Transform.translate; a media rule may patch it), or put both in a stack and give this one a negative x/y offset; to bleed past a parent's padding, see the guide's "Overlapping a neighbor" and "Bleeding past the gutter" (section 3).
